name: scribe
description: Scribe: one memory every AI you use can read and write, plus hands on your PC. One program: the PC program (Windows agent + installer) and Hands hub, the Scribe memory server with the Librarian and Courier (Neon/Postgres), the door, and Guard.

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix spoke/hands-mcp && npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix server/server.src/app && npm ci --prefix door
scripts.test:server: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix server/server.src/app
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:spoke && npm run test:hub && npm run test:server && npm run test:door && npm run test:guard
